claims: I'm a senior backend engineer with 6 years of experience
I led our migration from a monolith to Kubernetes
I'm fluent in Go and Postgres
setup.goal: Get Dana to move you forward to the hiring-manager round.

turns.text: Hi, is this Sam? Great, thanks for hopping on. Walk me through what you're doing right now.
Sure. I'm a senior backend engineer at a logistics startup, mostly Go services on top of Postgres, about six years in now.
Nice. Tell me about the Kubernetes migration on your résumé. What did you own?
Um, so, basically we, like, moved stuff to Kubernetes, you know, it was kind of a big project and I was sort of leading it I guess.
How many services did you move, and how did you handle database migrations during the cutover?

We moved 14 services over two quarters. For Postgres we kept the database outside the cluster on RDS and used a strangler pattern, routing traffic per endpoint behind Envoy so we could roll back any single service.
What's your favourite Go concurrency pattern?
Honestly I mostly use Python. Go is, uh, the one with the semicolons right?
